the preparation of starch nanocrystals and the use of these nanocrystals to reinforce PVA/starch and PVA/oleic acid-grafted starch nanocomposite films.
the preparation of biodegradable nanomaterials and their application for the preparation of packaging films.
the synthesis of PVA/Grafted starch and PVA/Starch-based biodegradable films reinforced with SNCs for packaging applications.

the PVA/Grafted starch nanocomposite film is the most suitable packaging material due to its improved mechanical, water barrier and biodegradability properties.

we have successfully synthesized PVA/modified starch-based nanocomposite films by incorporating SNCs into the matrix and studied their properties.

SNCs are a good reinforcement agent for the preparation of biodegradable nanomaterials for food packaging applications.
